purpose: Translate the CI workflow blueprint and backend issue backlog into GitHub branch protection, required checks, protected environments, release proof, and rollback rules for the future private backend repository.

protectedBranches.decision: No direct push, no force push, owner approval before production release.
Feature integration only after lint, typecheck, route envelopes, auth tenant, and redaction proof.
Release branches need staging rehearsal, artifacts, and owner go/no-go decision.
Emergency fixes still need tenant, access, commercial redaction, and audit proof.
Preserve audit traceability, release evidence, and rollback confidence.
Require fresh review after new commits change protected files.
No merge while release blockers or security questions are unresolved.
Use verified history when production backend work begins.

environmentGates.note: Safe UI and API preview for feature branches, no customer data.
Protected test tenant, scoped secrets, smoke report, and owner go/no-go.
Migration fixtures only after import dry run, restore proof, and redaction checks.
Checkout, invoices, webhooks, and seat sync run with test keys only.
Restricted evidence export requires governance owner signoff.
No production deploy until release summary, rollback plan, and sponsor decision exist.

reviewOwnership.scope: Repo shell, workflow files, protected branch setup, environment rules.
API shell, routes, services, validators, command bindings.
Tenant isolation, access denial, commercial redaction, safe errors.
Migrations, seeds, rollback, restore, count parity.
Import dry run, quarantine, source trace, reconciliation.
USD plan, test checkout, invoice lifecycle, webhook proof.
Staging smoke, acceptance proof, release artifact review.
Scope, non-goals, go/no-go, pilot handoff, release note.

artifactRetention.note: Status, duration, commit, PR, branch, and required-check list.
Denial cases protect tenant and commercial privacy.
Tracker list, detail, CSV, and search endpoints exclude restricted fields.
Migration files, rollback, restore, and count parity.
Webhook idempotency, invoice state, subscription sync, and seat locks.
Critical user paths, role checks, rollback proof, and report export.
Required checks, blockers, owners, artifacts, and go/no-go decision.

releaseRitual.title: Open PR from feature branch
releaseRitual.note: PR template links issue, scope, proof commands, migrations, rollback, and affected rooms.

releaseRitual.title: Run required checks
releaseRitual.note: Primary CI, security audit, migration restore, billing test mode, import dry run, and release gate must pass.

releaseRitual.title: Attach artifacts
releaseRitual.note: Route envelope, tenant proof, redaction proof, migration proof, billing proof, and release summary are visible.

releaseRitual.title: Review protected data
releaseRitual.note: Security owner confirms tracker payloads stay commercial-safe and denied routes audit correctly.

releaseRitual.title: Approve staging
releaseRitual.note: Staging alpha environment needs manual approval and scoped test secrets.

releaseRitual.title: Run smoke rehearsal
releaseRitual.note: Login, records, redaction, import, billing, feedback, audit, reports, and rollback proof run on seed data.

releaseRitual.title: Record go/no-go
releaseRitual.note: Product owner and platform owner sign the release summary before merge.

releaseRitual.title: Tag handoff
releaseRitual.note: Release note, rollback point, issue links, artifacts, and next defects are stored before the next sprint.

rollbackPlaybook.title: Identify bad commit
rollbackPlaybook.note: Use release-gate-summary.md, PR id, and workflow run id to identify the exact deploy candidate.

rollbackPlaybook.title: Freeze new merges
rollbackPlaybook.note: Pause merge queue and block production environment while impact is assessed.

rollbackPlaybook.title: Restore previous artifact
rollbackPlaybook.note: Redeploy the last passing build or revert the exact PR after owner approval.

rollbackPlaybook.title: Run smoke subset
rollbackPlaybook.note: Health, login, records, commercial denial, audit write, and report export must pass after rollback.

rollbackPlaybook.title: Check migration state
rollbackPlaybook.note: If schema changed, run rollback or forward-fix with restore proof and count parity.

rollbackPlaybook.title: Confirm billing mode
rollbackPlaybook.note: Make sure no live billing event replayed during rollback or staging rehearsal.

rollbackPlaybook.title: Write incident note
rollbackPlaybook.note: Audit the decision, actor, reason, affected rooms, and next corrective issue.

rollbackPlaybook.title: Reopen release gate
rollbackPlaybook.note: Only retry after failed check has a linked issue and fresh artifact proof.
